harness_label_revision.contract_text:
# Final native label audit contract

This is a one-time manual audit plan. No CAD job is authorized until the final
back-top export is ready and the parent releases the serial slot.

The actual nameplate and DATA poses, wing sections and retaining roofs stay
fixed. Their finite opposed backs and slot faces retain the ordinary static
0.15 mm and the existing local end/support allowances. Both wing tips retain
0.30 mm centred clearance and 0.15 mm at maximum sideways body travel.

The nameplate's actual finite floor-contact patches require complete 3.6 mm
normal backing, with the separately declared east relief retaining its full
2.14 mm. The PSU query includes the complete enlarged print-down pad end;
its old two-millimetre crop is too short for the larger pad.

DATA's actual finite floor-contact patches require complete 3.6 mm ordinary
normal backing. Remove only the exact authored aperture, purchased-body pocket
and 50-degree swing cutter, including its declared support allowance, from the
required stock prism. Do not remove a generic pocket bounding rectangle. Any
missing stock outside that exact functional void is a failure.

Check the jack material independently:

- Its actual finite front lip face is at Y467.79 and the actual finite pocket
  end is at Y464.79. Their common projected material requires a complete 3.00 mm
  normal stock prism.
- Each actual pocket cheek retains 3 mm normal material. A separate internal
  stock witness checks the complete cheek connection through to the wall root;
  the root coordinate is not described as an exposed mating face.
- The exact authored 50-degree swing wedge must remain open. Each surviving
  actual finite ease face must lie on its authored plane, with its actual
  vertices inside the prescribed X/Y/Z end bounds. The inherited diamond
  release opening can interrupt that surface; it does not create a requirement
  for a fictitious uninterrupted roof. Any extra finite thin residual outside
  the authored voids is reported for review.

After the final BT export, rerun the five stages that consume it: quads,
integrity, labels, rings and external-core. Then run the canonical mating survey
and existing heat-set audit once. Pump, windows, carrier and bedding results
retain their exact unchanged native inputs and frozen original source/harness
provenance; no rerun is claimed for them.

methods.planar_pairs: Original analytic planar faces are grouped by normal. Opposed faces are projected onto one plane and intersected to retain positive-area finite patches. Bounds only prefilter; crop faces are not contact witnesses. Native linear/area comparison tolerance is 1e-5. Each row retains face indices, normals, finite area, bounds, measured gap, required gap and actual-bed/support classification.
methods.print_finish: Production print-up is per part. A flat facing print-down receives one .25 mm supported allowance unless it is on that part's actual native bed plane. The bed face retains its ordinary allowance. No locating, seating, clamping, bearing, shoulder or stop exemption.
methods.quads: All ten pairs of the four quadrants and placed final frame; finite opposing planar patches within1.001 mm. Tangential X/Z and sloping slide faces use .25 mm; Y-normal head-on closure faces use .15 mm, plus applicable supported finish.
methods.integrity: Four complete3 mm washer-floor annuli and four manufacturer-required M5 radial backing envelopes are subtracted from their actual native hosts. Metal washer gap, screw reach and installed clamping behavior are not acceptance criteria of this stage.
methods.pump: Actual front-top/cartridge planar pairs and full native receiver-floor stock. The cartridge remains at its nominal station; floor room is .35 mm and declared retained floor is4.595 mm above the actual native bed.
methods.labels: Actual back-top, nameplate and DATA planar pairs at the final installed stations; complete3.6 mm ordinary backing prisms, the separately declared2.14 mm nameplate east backing, native tip/end surfaces at full body X travel, and actual receiver stock against the final placed PSU native input. DATA backing excludes only the exact authored functional jack cutter with its declared support relief. Actual finite3 mm jack lip, cheeks and root stock are checked separately. Every surviving finite50-degree ease face must match its authored plane and end bounds, and its intended swing void must be open. The inherited diamond release can interrupt that face; a fictitious full-width roof is not required.
methods.rings: Actual back-top and six individually placed ring native inputs; static backs and directional supported edge relief, with complete4 mm backing or3 mm at the CO2 land.
methods.windows: Actual front-bottom/front-top and west/east cover finite guided faces, floor and any finite supported roof. Full3 mm post fingers are checked by native missing-stock subtraction.
methods.carrier: Actual front-top at release and front-bottom at connection, finite roof/floor/fore faces, four native blind spring-floor surfaces and unchanged spring/stroke values against the recorded trial dimensions. The local low-force addition belongs only to the named carrier roof.
methods.bedding: Actual local front-bottom upper vertices are measured to finite45-degree front-top faces. The normal foot must land on that finite face; a projected silhouette alone is insufficient.
methods.external-core: Five external native core solids are identified individually by actual installed Z starts and print directions. Named finite floor/fore/flank/rear/crown windows require real opposing material; empty windows are not positive gaps. Full5.65 mm floor and8 mm hold-foot stock use native prism subtraction. No internal core/gasket fit review or whole-envelope motion search.
methods.canonical_quadrant_survey: The existing standalone checker supplies its own exact input hashes, finite patch rows and eleven explicit surface probes. Its report is embedded rather than replaced with a status-only link.
methods.cradle: Current canonical cradle finish supplies body validity/stock/capture and native subtraction. Exact protected hook/leaf equality plus unchanged frame transfers only the identified earlier hook/web/corner/silicone measurements. Identified route readings remain lower bounds under the measured no-added-stock subset; no whole-body candidate equality or new route fit is claimed.
